dct_description_sm: This project aims to determine long-term trends in contaminant loads in marine mammals of the Hudson Bay area and is done by the Nunavik Research Centre.  The Nunavik Research Centre is operated by Makivik Corporation, a non-profit organization created under the James Bay and Northern Qubec Agreement, which represents the interests of the Inuit of Nunavik. Since 1977, this facility has focused on climate change, contaminants and wildlife parasites research for Inuit in the region. (http://www.ainc-inac.gc.ca)
dct_title_s: Marine mammals disease monitoring program in Nunavik
